parameters.content:
✈️ SkyFlow FMS — n8n Production Automation

Each automation has its OWN trigger — no switch case!

Credentials needed:
1. Postgres account      → Supabase DB
2. Gmail account         → Gmail OAuth2
3. Google Gemini(PaLM)  → Embeddings
4. Groq account          → LLM
5. Pinecone account      → Vector store

Env vars:
  OPERATIONS_EMAIL — your admin email

parameters.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_flights FROM flights WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED';
INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_role, action, entity_type, new_data, reason, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'SYSTEM', 'KEEP_ALIVE_PING', 'system', '{"source":"n8n_keep_alive"}'::jsonb, 'Supabase keep-alive', NOW());

SELECT b.id AS booking_id, u.full_name, u.email, f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination, f.departure_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS departure_at FROM bookings b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id LEFT JOIN notification_logs n ON n.booking_id = b.id AND n.notification_type = 'CHECKIN_REMINDER' WHERE b.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND f.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND f.departure_at BETWEEN NOW() + INTERVAL '23 hours' AND NOW() + INTERVAL '25 hours' AND n.id IS NULL;

parameters.subject: =✈️ Check-in Reminder — {{ $json.flight_number }}
parameters.message:
=

✈️ Check-in Reminder

Dear {{ $json.full_name }},

Your flight departs in ~24 hours. Please check in online.

Flight{{ $json.flight_number }}
Route{{ $json.origin }} → {{ $json.destination }}
Departure{{ $json.departure_at }}

Safe travels — SkyFlow

parameters.query: INSERT INTO notification_logs (id, booking_id, notification_type, recipient_email, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), '{{ $json.booking_id }}'::uuid, 'CHECKIN_REMINDER', '{{ $json.email }}', NOW()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT w.id FROM waitlist_entries w
  JOIN seat_inventory s ON s.flight_id = w.flight_id AND s.seat_class = w.seat_class
  JOIN flights f ON f.id = w.flight_id
  WHERE w.status = 'WAITING'
    AND f.status <> 'CANCELLED'
    AND f.departure_at > NOW()
    AND s.available_seats >= 1
  ORDER BY w.priority_score ASC, w.created_at ASC
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE waitlist_entries w
SET status = 'PROMOTED', promoted_at = NOW(), claim_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
FROM candidate c WHERE w.id = c.id
RETURNING w.id AS waitlist_id, w.passenger_name, w.email, w.seat_class, w.fare_type, w.flight_id, w.claim_expires_at;

SELECT w.passenger_name AS full_name, w.email, f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination, f.departure_at, w.seat_class, w.fare_type, w.claim_expires_at FROM waitlist_entries w JOIN flights f ON f.id = w.flight_id WHERE w.id = '{{ $json.waitlist_id }}'::uuid;

Class{{ $json.seat_class }} — {{ $json.fare_type }}

parameters.query: SELECT r.id AS refund_id, r.booking_id, r.amount, r.currency, r.created_at, b.booking_reference, u.email AS passenger_email, u.full_name AS passenger_name, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - r.created_at)) / 86400 AS days_pending FROM refunds r JOIN bookings b ON b.id = r.booking_id JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.escalation_sent_at IS NULL AND r.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC;

parameters.subject: =⚠️ Refund Escalation — {{ $json.booking_reference }} ({{ Math.floor($json.days_pending) }} days)
parameters.message:
=

⚠️ Refund Needs Immediate Action

Refund ID{{ $json.refund_id }}
Booking{{ $json.booking_reference }}
Passenger{{ $json.passenger_name }} <{{ $json.passenger_email }}>
Amount{{ $json.currency }} {{ $json.amount }}
Pending Days{{ Math.floor($json.days_pending) }} days

Process immediately via admin dashboard.

parameters.query: UPDATE refunds SET escalation_sent_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{ $json.refund_id }}'::uuid;

SELECT f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination, f.status, f.departure_at::date AS dep_date, COALESCE(SUM(si.total_seats),0) AS total_seats, COALESCE(SUM(si.total_seats - si.available_seats - si.held_seats),0) AS booked, COALESCE(SUM(si.held_seats),0) AS held, COALESCE(SUM(b.total_amount),0) AS revenue FROM flights f LEFT JOIN seat_inventory si ON si.flight_id = f.id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.flight_id = f.id AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE f.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND f.departure_at >= NOW() AND f.departure_at < NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY f.id, f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination, f.status, f.departure_at ORDER BY f.departure_at;

parameters.subject: =📊 SkyFlow Daily Ops Report — {{ new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] }}

parameters.query: SELECT f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS bookings_week, COALESCE(SUM(b.total_amount),0) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.status='CANCELLED' THEN b.id END) AS cancellations FROM flights f LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.flight_id = f.id AND b.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE f.departure_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY f.id, f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT b.id, b.booking_reference, b.fare_type, b.total_amount, b.created_at, COUNT(p.id) AS passenger_count, u.email FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON p.booking_id = b.id AND p.status = 'CONFIRMED' JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY b.id, b.booking_reference, b.fare_type, b.total_amount, b.created_at, u.email;

parameters.jsCode: return items.map(i => { const b = i.json; const amt = Number(b.total_amount||0); const cnt = Number(b.passenger_count||1); let score = 0; const flags = []; if (cnt >= 5) { score+=40; flags.push('LARGE_GROUP'); } if (amt > 10000) { score+=30; flags.push('HIGH_SPEND'); } if (amt/cnt > 3000) { score+=20; flags.push('HIGH_PER_SEAT'); } const h = new Date(b.created_at).getUTCHours(); if (h>=2 && h<=5) { score+=15; flags.push('UNUSUAL_HOUR'); } return { json: { ...b, risk_score: score, risk_flags: flags.join(','), high_risk: score >= 50 } }; });

parameters.query: INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_role, action, entity_type, entity_id, new_data, reason, created_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), 'SYSTEM', 'FRAUD_SCAN_RESULT', 'booking', '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid, jsonb_build_object('booking_reference','{{ $json.booking_reference }}','risk_score',{{ $json.risk_score }},'risk_flags','{{ $json.risk_flags }}','high_risk',{{ $json.high_risk }}), 'Daily fraud scan', NOW());

WITH booking_fares AS (SELECT b.id AS booking_id, b.booking_reference, b.user_id, b.flight_id, b.seat_class, b.fare_type, b.total_amount, b.currency, COUNT(p.id) AS passenger_count, b.total_amount / NULLIF(COUNT(p.id),0) AS paid_per_seat FROM bookings b JOIN passengers p ON p.booking_id = b.id AND p.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE b.status = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY b.id, b.booking_reference, b.user_id, b.flight_id, b.seat_class, b.fare_type, b.total_amount, b.currency)
SELECT bf.booking_id, bf.booking_reference, u.email, u.full_name, f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination, f.departure_at, bf.seat_class, bf.fare_type, bf.paid_per_seat, CASE WHEN bf.fare_type='BASIC' THEN si.fare_basic ELSE si.fare_flexible END AS current_fare, bf.currency, ROUND(CAST((bf.paid_per_seat - CASE WHEN bf.fare_type='BASIC' THEN si.fare_basic ELSE si.fare_flexible END) AS numeric),2) AS savings_per_seat, ROUND(CAST(((bf.paid_per_seat - CASE WHEN bf.fare_type='BASIC' THEN si.fare_basic ELSE si.fare_flexible END)/NULLIF(bf.paid_per_seat,0)*100) AS numeric),1) AS drop_pct FROM booking_fares bf JOIN users u ON u.id = bf.user_id JOIN flights f ON f.id = bf.flight_id JOIN seat_inventory si ON si.flight_id = bf.flight_id AND si.seat_class = bf.seat_class LEFT JOIN notification_logs n ON n.booking_id = bf.booking_id AND n.notification_type = 'PRICE_DROP' AND n.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE f.status='SCHEDULED' AND f.departure_at > NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day' AND n.id IS NULL AND CASE WHEN bf.fare_type='BASIC' THEN si.fare_basic ELSE si.fare_flexible END < bf.paid_per_seat * 0.90 ORDER BY drop_pct DESC;

SELECT b.id AS booking_id, b.booking_reference, b.fare_type, b.cancellation_policy, b.flight_cancellation_outcome AS cancellation_outcome, b.status, u.full_name, u.email, f.flight_number, f.origin, f.destination FROM bookings b JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id WHERE b.booking_reference = '{{ $json.booking_reference }}' LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode: const text = $json.policy_text || ''; const size = 900, overlap = 150; const chunks = []; for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += size - overlap) { const chunk = text.slice(i, i + size); if (chunk.trim().length > 50) chunks.push({ json: { pageContent: chunk, metadata: { source: 'skyflow-policy', chunk: chunks.length } } }); } return chunks;
